top_signals.title: SONAR launches new routing guide and contract rate data, plus expanded SearchCarriers monitoring
top_signals.summary:
New SONAR datasets show what shippers pay brokers and carriers when freight falls past the first tender, plus SearchCarriers watchlists and alerts.
